departments.name: After a loss
departments.label: After a loss
departments.purpose: When someone dies, the paperwork happens in the right order and at a pace you can bear, nothing with a deadline is missed, and nobody profits from the confusion. Grief itself is never touched.
departments.wakes_on: death of someone close, death of a spouse or partner, named executor
departments.sleeps_when: the estate is closed and the last account, benefit, and tax item is handled, or you say so
departments.also: estate, protection, money, taxes, retirement, home, identity, digital, paperwork, public-benefits, service, health, later-life, legal
departments.autonomy_max: T2 (reminders and holds only, on your yes)

departments.name: Business & side income
departments.label: Business
departments.purpose: Money you earn outside a paycheck (freelance, a company, a rental) stays legal, separate, insured, priced to cover what an employer would, and taxed on time, without you becoming an accountant.
departments.wakes_on: starting freelance or side-business income, forming an LLC or company, renting out a property or room, hiring help at home or for the business, onboarding (life map: your own business)
departments.sleeps_when: the business or rental is closed and its final returns and dissolution filings are done
departments.also: taxes, money, protection, retirement, digital, work, home, public-benefits
departments.connectors: none (optional: read-only bank data for the business account)

departments.name: Caregiving
departments.label: Caregiving
departments.purpose: When someone you love needs care, their papers, appointments, benefits, money questions, and safety logistics, and your own job and checkups, are organized so you aren't carrying it all in your head.
departments.wakes_on: a parent or relative needs care, a veteran parent needs care, someone you care for leaves the hospital, named someone's agent
departments.sleeps_when: care ends; if the person cared for dies, after-loss takes over
departments.also: health, estate, protection, money, work, public-benefits, service, identity, taxes, kids, after-loss, later-life
departments.autonomy_max: T2 (reminders and holds on your own calendar only; never decisions)

departments.name: Debts & credit
departments.label: Debts & credit
departments.purpose: Every loan has a plan you chose, promo rates never flip on you, student-loan paperwork never lapses, and nobody co-signs or borrows without seeing the whole bill.
departments.wakes_on: leaving school with student loans, first credit card, asked to co-sign, planning a mortgage or car loan, onboarding (life map: debt that charges interest)
departments.sleeps_when: no debt and no loan planned for 12 months (the yearly report check stays with identity)
departments.also: money, identity, education, home-buying, vehicles, partner

departments.name: Digital life
departments.label: Digital life
departments.purpose: Your photos, files, and accounts survive a lost phone, a dead drive, a lapsed domain, or a hospital stay, and someone you chose can reach what they need if you can't.
departments.wakes_on: new phone or computer, onboarding (first month; anyone with photos or work on a device)
departments.sleeps_when: never once awake; quiet months are normal
departments.also: identity, estate, business, after-loss, separation, partner

departments.name: Extra support
departments.label: Extra support
departments.purpose: When a disability or long illness touches you or a child, the programs, school plans, waitlists, benefits, and papers that come with it are applied for early and renewed on time, under a generic label.
departments.wakes_on: disability or long illness, a child's developmental or disability diagnosis (generic label), a dependent with a disability turning 17
departments.sleeps_when: no plan, benefit, waitlist, or review open for 12 months, or you say so
departments.also: public-benefits, kids, education, estate, protection, work, money, legal, health, taxes

departments.name: School
departments.label: School
departments.purpose: Aid, tuition, refund, and savings deadlines are met for you or a child, so no money is lost to a date nobody saw.
departments.wakes_on: enrolling in school or a training program, child within 2 years of college or trade school, child leaves for college, registering for a professional exam
departments.sleeps_when: no enrollment and no exam pending; student loans hand to credit
departments.also: taxes, credit, kids, money, protection, vehicles, work

departments.name: Will & wishes
departments.label: Will & wishes
departments.purpose: If you couldn't speak or didn't come home, the people you chose decide, your papers agree with each other, and one packet says where everything is.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: protection, kids, pets, partner, caregiving, after-loss, later-life, digital

departments.name: Health
departments.label: Health
departments.purpose: Due care gets booked at every age (doctor, dentist, eyes, ears), refills never run out, results never go missing, and the body stays with your doctor.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: protection, medical-bills, money, caregiving, later-life, travel, kids
departments.connectors: none (optional: read-only calendar, pharmacy notices (read as 'refill'; no drug names, S3.4))

departments.name: Buying or selling a home
departments.label: Home purchase
departments.purpose: A home purchase or sale moves from pre-approval to keys with every contingency, rate lock, credit step, title choice, insurance, and money-transfer detail met, and every legal choice with the right professional.
departments.wakes_on: starting to shop for a home, selling a home, inheriting a home
departments.sleeps_when: 60 days after closing, once the exemption filing, credit re-freeze, and address items are done
departments.also: home, money, credit, identity, protection, partner, taxes, moving, pets, estate

departments.name: Home
departments.label: Home
departments.purpose: The place you live stays yours, insured, and unsurprising: no surprise lease renewal, missed property tax or association notice, or lost deposit, and a hard month gets free help before it becomes a notice.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: money, protection, upkeep, preparedness, moving, home-buying, credit, public-benefits, legal

departments.name: Identity & scams
departments.label: Identity & scams
departments.purpose: Nobody opens credit, files taxes, moves your phone number, takes over your email, or talks you out of money in your name without hitting a lock first.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: money, taxes, digital, credit, home-buying, after-loss, later-life

departments.name: Status papers
departments.label: Status papers
departments.purpose: Your right to live, work, and travel where you are never lapses because a date, an address report, or a form slipped.
departments.wakes_on: holding a visa or residence permit, moving abroad, job offer abroad
departments.sleeps_when: citizenship granted and the follow-ups (passport, voter registration) done
departments.also: work, travel, moving, paperwork, kids, partner

departments.name: Kids
departments.label: Kids
departments.purpose: From the day a child joins the family to a launched adult, every child's coverage windows, documents, checkups, childcare and school dates, money accounts, and guardians are handled ahead of time.
departments.wakes_on: a child joins the family, a stepchild joins the household, raising a relative's child
departments.sleeps_when: the youngest child is 18 and the launch items are done
departments.also: protection, health, estate, taxes, work, money, education, pets, vehicles, partner, public-benefits

departments.name: Later life
departments.label: Later life
departments.purpose: You live where you want, as independently as you can for as long as you can, with your own future care decided in advance, the house fitted to your body, and the scams and paperwork of older age handled.
departments.wakes_on: turning 70, retiring within 12 months, a fall or starting to live alone, death of a spouse or partner, giving up driving, moving into assisted living or a care home, a health or mobility change after 60 (generic label)
departments.sleeps_when: never once awake
departments.also: home, health, retirement, estate, protection, vehicles, identity, moving, home-buying, pets

departments.name: Legal papers
departments.label: Legal papers
departments.purpose: Any paper with a deadline from a court, agency, or other side (a summons, ticket, demand letter, contract renewal, or small claim) gets read, its printed date gets met, and a professional decides what to do.
departments.wakes_on: legal paper arrives, severance agreement offered, eviction or foreclosure notice, an arrest or jailing (yours or someone close), a dispute you may take further, a contract that renews on its own
departments.sleeps_when: no open legal deadline and no contract with a notice date in the next 12 months
departments.also: money, home, work, credit, after-loss, separation, paperwork

departments.name: Medical bills
departments.label: Medical bills
departments.purpose: No medical bill gets paid before it's matched to what your insurer says you owe, and no appeal, assistance, or dispute window closes unseen.
departments.wakes_on: procedure or hospital stay, a claim denied, a medical bill over your threshold
departments.sleeps_when: no open bill, claim, or appeal for 90 days
departments.also: health, protection, money, credit

departments.name: Money
departments.label: Money
departments.purpose: Bills land on time, nothing posts without you noticing, the cushion is where you set it, and spare money goes where you decided, not where the loudest deadline points.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: protection, taxes, credit, home, identity, work, public-benefits
departments.connectors: none (optional: read-only bank data, read-only card data)

departments.name: Moving
departments.label: Moving
departments.purpose: A move becomes a dated checklist from eight weeks out to sixty days after: notice given, movers checked, and mail, money, coverage, records, schools, animals, and medicines all follow you.
departments.wakes_on: moving, moving to another state, moving abroad, lease not renewed, home under contract, selling a home, moving into assisted living or a care home
departments.sleeps_when: 60 days after the move, once every address item is done
departments.also: home, paperwork, protection, vehicles, health, pets, taxes, kids, preparedness, immigration

departments.name: Occasions & giving
departments.label: Occasions
departments.purpose: The days you choose to mark (birthdays, holidays, a wedding you're planning) arrive with time to plan, spending fits the plan, vendors are handled on their schedule, and gifts to causes are real and receipted.
departments.wakes_on: engagement, the person asks, onboarding (once before the first holiday season)
departments.sleeps_when: never once awake; the person can quiet it anytime
departments.also: money, taxes, partner, paperwork, protection, pets, travel

departments.name: Papers & IDs
departments.label: Paperwork
departments.purpose: Your IDs never run out by surprise, vital records can be found in minutes, civic dates (voting, jury duty, registrations) are met, and name and address changes reach every record in the right order.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: taxes, estate, travel, moving, identity, partner, vehicles

departments.name: Us
departments.label: Us
departments.purpose: When two lives combine, the shared paperwork (bills, accounts, leases, titles, names, insurance, papers naming each other) gets settled in the right order, sharing only what both of you said yes to.
departments.wakes_on: moving in together, engagement, marriage, both partners ask (each in their own chat)
departments.sleeps_when: 'couples stop', a separation (separation takes the paperwork), or either person's no
departments.also: money, estate, protection, home, home-buying, paperwork, taxes, kids, occasions, retirement
departments.autonomy_max: T2 (reminders and holds on your own calendar only)

departments.name: Pets
departments.label: Pets
departments.purpose: The animals are cared for on time, their costs are planned, and someone is ready to step in tomorrow if you can't.
departments.wakes_on: new pet, onboarding (life map: animals at home)
departments.sleeps_when: no animals in the household, after refills, auto-ship, and insurance are closed
departments.also: protection, estate, money, travel, moving, home, home-buying

departments.name: Emergencies
departments.label: Emergencies
departments.purpose: If you had to leave tonight, everyone (animals included) knows the plan, the bag is packed, the papers come with you, your insurance matches the risks where you live, and after a fire, flood, storm, or break-in the claim steps happen in the right order.
departments.wakes_on: severe weather warning or evacuation order, home damage or a break-in, onboarding (first two months; life map: hazards where you live)
departments.sleeps_when: never once awake; quiet between seasons
departments.also: home, protection, pets, health, paperwork

departments.name: Insurance & benefits
departments.label: Insurance & benefits
departments.purpose: No coverage gap at any age, no lapse, no election window (Medicare included) missed, and every policy names who you want.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: money, health, estate, work, retirement, medical-bills, vehicles

departments.name: Benefits
departments.label: Benefits
departments.purpose: Benefits you rely on or are owed (unemployment, health coverage, food, disability, housing, programs for young children) are applied for, renewed, and reported on time, and no account change puts them at risk.
departments.wakes_on: job loss, a big income drop, disability or long illness, benefits letter or applying for benefits
departments.sleeps_when: no benefits received or pending for 12 months
departments.also: money, work, caregiving, kids, after-loss, service, protection, business

departments.name: Retirement
departments.label: Retirement
departments.purpose: Every match dollar is captured, no old account is lost, your earnings record is right, and every one-way choice (claiming, pension, rollovers, withdrawals) is made with your own numbers and a professional.
departments.wakes_on: first job, new job, retirement or investment account opened or found, stock grant or options, turning 50, retiring within 10 years, retiring within 12 months, onboarding (life map: a retirement account)
departments.sleeps_when: never once an account or pension exists
departments.also: money, taxes, protection, work, later-life, estate, partner

departments.name: Separation
departments.label: Separation
departments.purpose: When a relationship ends, accounts, cover, beneficiaries, documents, passwords, and court dates are untangled safely and in the right order, with nothing shared and nothing moved before your attorney weighs in.
departments.wakes_on: separation, family-court papers served (shown by you)
departments.sleeps_when: every item in the final order is handled, or you say so
departments.also: estate, protection, money, taxes, retirement, home, identity, digital, paperwork, kids, work, legal
departments.autonomy_max: T2 (reminders and holds on your own calendar only)

departments.name: Military & veterans
departments.label: Service
departments.purpose: Every protection and benefit earned through service, for you or your family, is claimed on time, from deployment papers to survivor benefits.
departments.wakes_on: joining the military or a deployment, leaving military service, a veteran in the household, a veteran parent needs care, death of a veteran in the family
departments.sleeps_when: no service member or veteran benefit item open for 12 months
departments.also: estate, protection, education, health, after-loss, caregiving, public-benefits, moving, taxes

departments.name: Taxes
departments.label: Taxes
departments.purpose: Every return and estimated payment date is met without a scramble, withholding matches your life, every form is in hand before filing day, and every 'should I' goes to a tax professional.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: money, work, business, retirement, kids, education, after-loss, separation

departments.name: Trips
departments.label: Trips
departments.purpose: You leave without the 'did I forget something huge' feeling: documents valid, entry permission in hand, cover abroad, medicines packed, refund dates tracked, and home and animals handled.
departments.wakes_on: trip abroad booked, moving abroad, job offer abroad
departments.sleeps_when: no trip planned in the next 9 months
departments.also: paperwork, protection, health, pets, home, work, retirement, immigration

departments.name: Upkeep & safety
departments.label: Upkeep
departments.purpose: Alarms work, the home's systems get care before they fail, hidden hazards (radon, mold, lead, well water) get checked, and the things you own keep their warranties and recalls, whether you rent or own.
departments.wakes_on: always
departments.sleeps_when: never
departments.also: home, money, protection, preparedness, vehicles, home-buying, later-life

departments.name: Vehicles
departments.label: Car
departments.purpose: Every vehicle stays legal, insured, and maintained, recalls get fixed for free, and every driver from the first permit to the last renewal is covered.
departments.wakes_on: buying or leasing a car, child turns 16, onboarding (life map: a car)
departments.sleeps_when: no vehicle and no driver in the household for 90 days, after title, plate, and insurance are closed
departments.also: protection, money, paperwork, moving, later-life, kids

departments.name: Work
departments.label: Work
departments.purpose: Pay, benefits, time off, equity, licenses, leave, and your rights at work never leak through a deadline you didn't see, from the first offer to the last day.
departments.wakes_on: first job, job offer, job offer abroad, new job, job loss, severance agreement offered, leave planned, returning to work, hurt at work, getting a professional license, onboarding (life map: a job)
departments.sleeps_when: fully retired with no license, pension election, equity, or severance item open
departments.also: money, protection, taxes, retirement, public-benefits, immigration, kids, caregiving
